headings.font_family: Chivo, Cabinet Grotesk, or Söhne equivalent
headings.description: Used for marketing hero and large impact text. Crisp, serious, enterprise feel. Avoid Inter.

body.font_family: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, or Berkeley Mono equivalent
body.description: For technical density, data tables, code editor previews, and UI labels. Enhances the 'engineer tool' aesthetic.

accents.description: For overlines, badges, status indicators, and chiplet pin labels.

typography.instructions: Import these fonts via Google Fonts (e.g. Chivo and JetBrains Mono) or standard web imports. Use tight tracking for headings (tracking-tight) and standard or loose tracking for mono body.

colors.description: Silicon slate and dark navy base. Avoid pure black. Oscilloscope green (#10B981) as the primary neon accent, with Ion-blue (#0EA5E9) for secondary data and Phosphor amber (#F59E0B) for warnings/highlights. Completely avoid AI-slop purple/violet gradients.

motifs: Grid dot patterns: Use radial-gradient masks over CSS dot grids to represent chip substrate.
PCB traces: 1px glowing lines (using box-shadow or neon borders) across section dividers or active card edges.
Silicon die texture: Noise/grain overlays with low opacity (5-10%) on elevated dark cards.
surfaces: Technical Dashboard: Use border-collapse style grids for the dashboard. Expose the skeleton, 1px subtle borders on right/bottom of grid items.
Cards: Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border (#1E293B), no drop shadows by default. Use a 1px bright border (e.g., border-t-emerald-500) to indicate active/selected state.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers. Use backdrop-blur-md with bg-[#0B0E14]/80 to maintain readabilty of navigation.

structure: Hero: Deep dark background, large expressive typography (Chivo), overlaid on a dark silicon wafer visual with grid pattern. Includes Waitlist CTA.
Features (Bento Grid): 6 modules (Testbench gen, Assertion gen, etc.) in an asymmetrical bento grid. Each card has a subtle top border accent.
Use Cases: Tabbed layout for Block, IP, Subsystem, SoC, Chiplet. Monospace labels and technical line-art styling.
Languages: Supported HDL languages presented as hardware pin/badge components.
Pricing: High contrast cards. Pro/Enterprise highlighted with a glowing oscilloscope green border.
Sidebar (Left Nav): Compact, minimal width. Uses Lucide or Phosphor icons. Active state highlighted with a neon left border.
Main Workspace: Dense layout (gap-4). High density grid for coverage heatmaps, AI generation modules, and waveform viewers.
Code Editor: Monaco editor embedded in a panel with terminal-like styling (sharp corners, 1px solid borders, no shadows).
AI Panel: Module picker + Model switcher. Streaming output area styled like a CLI terminal with mono font.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on buttons (slight color shift and border glow), active links get a 1px border highlight. AI generating state should use a shimmering text or blinking cursor effect.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade (Framer Motion) - keep it snappy for engineers.
motion.data_viz: Waveforms should render cleanly, avoiding excessive bounce. Professional, hardware-level precision.

component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). Technical feel. Primary button uses solid oscilloscope green with dark text, or hollow with neon green border.
component_rules.cards: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). 1px border of #1E293B. Flat surfaces, no large drop shadows.
component_rules.forms: Inputs should have #121721 background, #1E293B border, and focus-ring of #10B981. Mono fonts for input text.

hero_background.description: Vibrant detailed close-up of a patterned silicon wafer with green/blue hues. Use as hero background with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80) and grid pattern.

features_texture.description: Close up of a computer circuit board. Great for feature card backgrounds with high opacity mask (bg-black/90) to show subtle circuit traces.

tech_accent.description: Detailed view of circuit board showing electronic traces. Use for decorative sections or waitlist background.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (standard) or @phosphor-icons/react for more technical weight.
libraries.animation: framer-motion for bento grid staggering and terminal text reveals.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize a serious enterprise deep-tech aesthetic. Avoid rounded bubbly UI, avoid generic purple gradients. Stick to the 'oscilloscope green / ion-blue' neon on slate dark mode.
Use standard Tailwind classes. For custom grid patterns, use inline styles with radial-gradients or linear-gradients.
Ensure all text against dark backgrounds meets APCA contrast standards. Never use pure #000000 for backgrounds, use #0B0E14.
Data-testid attributes MUST be added to all interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container. Keep a left-aligned or CSS Grid layout for technical precision.
For the dashboard, use Shadcn UI components extensively (tabs, sidebars, select, sliders) but override their border-radius to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` for a sharper, engineering look.
Do NOT apply global transitions like `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Never use AI emoji placeholders (🤖🧠💭). Use proper SVG icons.
